thread:
ella (partnerships): quick heads-up — kickoff for asia-east-north-1 (aen1) marketplace onramp. primary asks: quota approvals, HW partner capacity confirmation (CloudQ), and legal entitlements. timeline target: soft-launch w/in 3 weeks.

mike (cloud-ops): noted. can you paste expected SKU/VM counts? we need to pre-request quotas with providers.

ella (partnerships): target steady-state = 24 vGPUs (8x A100 equivalent), burst pool 8 vGPUs. initial reserved commit = 32 vGPUs. SKU mapping from CloudQ: aen1.large-gpu (x8), aen1.burst (x8).

andrew (eng-infra): for Dedicated routing we also need nodepool templates + startup scripts. Michael, do you want the terraform snippet now or after quota approval?

mike (cloud-ops): terraform now please. ops can parallel quota requests but prefer config to match exactly.

ella (partnerships): copying terraform snippet for the marketplace listing & entitlement request:

```
resource "azurerm_marketplace_agreement" "aen1" {
  offer   = "redwood-inference-aen1"
  plan    = "dedicated"
  license = file("./LICENSE.pdf")
}
```

sara (cloudq-partner): CloudQ confirms availability in aen1. We can reserve 32 vGPUs for the commit window. Need signed commercial SOW + KMS details for Bring-Your-Own-Key flows. ETA to provision: 5 business days after SOW.

jess (product): announcement timing? Marketing wants a 2-week heads-up before soft-launch. Also need to bake in console integration for "region" dropdown — is that blocked?

andrew (eng-infra): console change is small (route + region metadata) but requires model catalog flagging. I can ship a feature branch; needs QA. Blocker: KMS integration test tokens.

ella (partnerships): legal-bot — ping for entitlements checklist and required contract clauses for CloudQ-managed hardware.

legal-bot: See checklist: list of required clauses: data residency, audit rights, SOC2 addendum, KMS responsibilities. Also need partner DPA signed. ETA review: 48 hours.

mike (cloud-ops): action items summary:
- Partnerships: SOW + partner contact (ella)
- CloudQ: confirm provisioning window + KMS handshake endpoint (sara)
- Eng-infra: terraform + console PR (andrew)
- Legal: DPA + entitlements review (legal-bot)

ella (partnerships): I'll attach SOW draft and partner contact. tagging @sara for KMS endpoint url. also request quota ticket numbers once raised. :thumbsup:

sara (cloudq-partner): KMS endpoint: https://kms.cloudq.example/aen1/handshake — we'll whitelist redwood IPs after SOW. I'll open a provisioning ticket once SOW is signed.

andrew (eng-infra): dropping a small smoke test we can run after provisioning:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" https://aen1.api.redwood.dev/v1/models/test-generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Expect 200 and <150ms p99 for tiny model.

jess (product): ok. marketing freeze -> we aim for branch cut in 10 business days, soft-launch in 3 weeks if legal/quotas green.

mike (cloud-ops): thanks. adding this to our capacity board.

sara (cloudq-partner): happy to help — will queue provisioning and KMS onboarding once SOW signed.
